data.mensagem: Coach, bad news. With the bus strike, the metro delays and the Dragão closures, I set off on foot. A group of pilgrims adopted me and I can't leave them. I can't make leg day, but I'll double the squats on Monday. That's a promise.
data.resumo: Pilgrims adopted me during the strike

desculpa_absurda.titulo: With the strike I walked and a group of pilgrims adopted me along the way

cenas.legenda: Bus 500 on strike. Nobody is coming.
I walk towards the gym, brave and sporty.
Pilgrims spot me and adopt me instantly.
We sing hymns beside the closed roads.
I finally arrive. No legs left.

entrevista.titulo: Pilgrims explain why they adopted a gym-goer
entrevista.entrevistada: Dona Amélia and the Porto pilgrims, a group of cheerful walkers on the way to Fátima

perguntas.r: He was walking alone during the strike, looked lost, and we can't leave a young man behind.
He mentioned leg day, but we told him walking with us is much better training.
Only after the rosary and a nice cup of cimbalino. Then we'll see.

resposta1.texto: PILGRIMS?! OK, FIRST OF ALL, HOW MANY STEPS DID YOU DO? THAT'S CARDIO!
LEG DAY MISSED IS FORGIVEN. MONDAY YOU OWE ME DOUBLE SQUATS AND 20 PRESS-UPS FOR THE PILGRIMS!

noticia_link.manchete: Cheerful pilgrims adopt lost gym-goer on the road to Fátima
noticia_link.lead: Dona Amélia and the Porto pilgrims say they couldn't leave a young man behind during the strike.

votos.comentario: Ai, filho, with the bus, the metro and the Dragão all in a tangle, I believe you walked, and pilgrims adopting a lost lamb is very Porto of them. But 'double the squats on Monday' is a promise I'll be checking, because a promise made on an empty stomach is worth no more than a bag of wind. Off you go, and do say thank you to the pilgrims!

Pilgrims, strikes, metro chaos, and not a single gull in sight? I've seen more drama in a discarded chip wrapper at Ribeira, and at least that had a seagull in it. Come back when a gaggle of gulls has masterminded your disappearance, and I might look up from my sardine.

The strike, the metro delays and the Dragão closures are all labelled simulated data, which makes them about as verifiable as the pilgrims who supposedly adopted you. Walking is admirable, but I see no source for the pilgrims, and doubling the squats on Monday does not constitute evidence.
